main_text.p: 2. Desiderium iuge profitendi & propagandi doctrinam cœlestē, propter Dei gloriam.
3. Ἐπιχαρ[?]αγαθία[?] cum Verbi & Sacramentum administratione ædificatur Ecclesia.
4. Nemesis & ingens dolor, cum Ecclesiæ desunt fidi pastores, & præsunt hypocrytæ aut mercenarij, cauponantes verbum Dei: aut cum idololatræ loca tenet, & idololatriam exercent.
5. Sensus præsentiæ Spiritus sancti, & usus donorum quibus opus est ad plantandum & rigandum Ecclesiæ aruum.
1. Occasiones ꝑficiendi in studio Theologico propter doctorum, librorum, condiscipulorum, ocij, sumtuum, copiam.
2. Parentum & liberorum voluntas cō-sentiens, sed quæ sæpe spe honoris, quæstus, successionis in officio, magis commouent, quàm studio sanctificandi nomen Dei.
Danda est autem opera, ut mente pura & spontanea, ac in Dei solius gloriam & Ecclesiæ ædificationem respiciente, sacrum istud professionis Theologicæ ge

page.notes: Greek word at the start of item 3 is only partly legible: its letters after "Ἐπιχαρ" are uncertain, so the whole word is marked. The catchword "nus" at the lower right is faint. The line-end "ge" at the foot of the text is cut off and has no printed hyphen. The abbreviation "ꝑ" in "pficiendi" is read from a superscript stroke. The printed "fed" and "fuccefsionis" are read as "sed" and "successionis" (long s). The printed "hypocrytæ" is kept as printed.
